verdicts.reason: A: a big two-line headline and a clear orange CTA on the right read in the right order, but the legal fine print sits first in the left column, crammed into a tiny unreadable block next to a miniscule can and logo, and the 'Longest Day Sale' ribbon has shrunk to an illegible sliver under the headline. B is worse: the legal copy is set almost as large as the headline and takes up the middle, while the CTA and sale ribbon are squeezed into tiny chips in the far-left corner, so the action is buried and the fine print competes with the message.
